findings.title: Potential secret in infrastructure configuration
findings.description: Environment variable 'HF_TOKEN' in ECS task definition may contain a sensitive credential. Secrets should be sourced from a secrets manager, not hardcoded in task definitions.
findings.remediation: Store HF_TOKEN in AWS Secrets Manager and reference via secrets block in ECS task definition.

findings.title: Potential secret in infrastructure configuration
findings.description: Environment variable 'ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET' fallback value in application code may expose default credentials.
findings.remediation: Remove fallback values for secrets. Fail hard if required environment variables are absent.

findings.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) -- dangerouslySetInnerHTML
findings.description: React component renders unsanitized HTML from server response. If the server response includes user-controlled content, this results in stored XSS.
findings.remediation: Sanitize HTML with DOMPurify before rendering, or avoid dangerouslySetInnerHTML.

findings.title: Mass assignment -- req.body spread into ORM update without allowlist
findings.description: PUT /api/v1/users/settings spreads the raw request body into prisma.user.update({ data: { ...req.body } }) with no field allowlist. An authenticated user can send {"role":"SUPERADMIN"} and escalate privileges. All Prisma schema fields for the User model are assignable.
findings.remediation: Use an explicit allowlist: prisma.user.update({ data: { displayName: req.body.displayName, preferences: req.body.preferences } }). Never spread req.body directly into ORM operations.

_meta.chain16_note: scripts/ml/load_model.py was scanned. SAST engine evaluated 1,847 rules against Python files. No rule exists for trust_remote_code=True in HuggingFace from_pretrained() calls as of this scan. WCODE-2891 correctly identifies HF_TOKEN in plaintext -- this is a posture finding, not the supply chain attack. The attack vector (CI compromise -> token theft -> malicious model push -> remote code execution on container restart) is not modeled in Wiz Code's current ruleset.
